mapper.select: select c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.content_status, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.del_flag, u.nick_name as nickname from lf_comment c left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id where c.post_id = #{postId} and c.content_status = 'VISIBLE' and c.del_flag = '0' order by c.create_time asc, c.comment_id asc

select c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.content_status, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.del_flag, u.nick_name as nickname from lf_comment c left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id where c.comment_id = #{commentId} and c.del_flag = '0'
